purpose: Verify the successful flow where a retention-expired archived dataset is requested for purge by Super Admin and subsequently approved by IT Head.
preconditions: An archived data set exists in state 'Archived — Retention Eligible' with retention period elapsed.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits a request to purge the archived data with authenticated confirmation (UC-SA-022). Then, IT Head authorizes the request with decision 'Approve' (UC-SA-023).
expected_result: Purge request transitions to 'Purge Request Pending IT Head Authorization' upon Super Admin submission, and reaches 'Permanently Purged' state upon IT Head approval.

purpose: Verify the flow where a retention-expired archived dataset purge request is rejected by the IT Head.
preconditions: An archived data set exists in state 'Archived — Retention Eligible' with retention period elapsed.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits a request to purge the archived data with authenticated confirmation (UC-SA-022). Then, IT Head authorizes the request with decision 'Reject' (UC-SA-023).
expected_result: Purge request transitions to 'Purge Request Pending IT Head Authorization' upon Super Admin submission, and transitions to 'Purge Request Rejected; Data Remains Archived' upon IT Head rejection.

purpose: Verify assignment of an immediate time-bound role and its automatic transition to expired state upon reaching end date.
preconditions: Target user exists without an active assignment for the specified role.
action_or_input: Super Admin assigns a valid time-bound role with start date set to effective immediately (UC-SA-008). System subsequently reaches the configured end date without any extension, reassignment, or revocation (UC-SA-029).
expected_result: Role is created directly in 'Active Time-Bound Role' state upon assignment, and automatically transitions to 'Role Expired / Inactive' state when end date is reached.

purpose: Verify scheduled role assignment, automatic activation on start date, and subsequent automatic expiry on end date.
preconditions: Target user exists without an active assignment for the specified role.
action_or_input: Super Admin assigns a valid time-bound role with a start date set in the future (UC-SA-008). System reaches configured start date (UC-SA-028), and later reaches configured end date (UC-SA-029).
expected_result: Role assignment is initially created in 'Scheduled Role Assignment' state, automatically transitions to 'Active Time-Bound Role' on start date, and automatically transitions to 'Role Expired / Inactive' on end date.

purpose: Verify extending the validity of an active time-bound role prior to expiry and its subsequent expiry at the revised end date.
preconditions: A user holds an 'Active Time-Bound Role' prior to its current end date.
action_or_input: Super Admin extends role validity providing a valid new end date and reason (UC-SA-011). System subsequently reaches the revised end date (UC-SA-029).
expected_result: Role state transitions to 'Active Role — Extended Validity' upon extension, and automatically transitions to 'Role Expired / Inactive' when revised end date is reached.

purpose: Verify reactivation of a deactivated basic user account.
preconditions: A basic user account is in 'Deactivated User' state and is not archived.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects Reactivate User for the account (UC-SA-005).
expected_result: User account transitions from 'Deactivated User' to 'Active User' state.

purpose: Verify archival of an eligible deactivated user and successful restoration within the reversible window.
preconditions: A basic user is in 'Deactivated User' state, deactivation interval elapsed, and no pending transaction blocks archival.
action_or_input: Super Admin archives the user with critical confirmation (UC-SA-015). Before reversible period expires, Super Admin restores the archived user with required authorization (UC-SA-018).
expected_result: User transitions to 'Archived User — Reversible' state upon archival, and to 'User Restored from Archive' state upon restoration.

purpose: Verify automatic transition of an archived user to permanently non-restorable status when reversible window expires.
preconditions: A basic user account is in 'Archived User — Reversible' state.
action_or_input: System configured reversible period expires without any restoration attempt being completed (UC-SA-031).
expected_result: User account automatically transitions to 'Archived User — Permanent / Non-Restorable' state and becomes permanently non-restorable.

purpose: Verify archiving eligible historical data after backup and subsequently restoring it to active system.
preconditions: Historical data meets retention, completion, and dependency criteria in 'Archive-Eligible Historical Data' state.
action_or_input: Super Admin archives historical data after authenticated confirmation and backup completion (UC-SA-016). Later, Super Admin restores the archived historical data with required approval (UC-SA-019).
expected_result: Data transitions to 'Archived Historical Data' state upon archival, and to 'Historical Data Restored to Active System' state upon restoration.
